description: This file is the main entry point for a Vue.js application, setting up application creation, state management with Pinia, routing, and mounting the app to a DOM element.

methods.name: app.use
methods.description: Registers plugins or middleware like Pinia and router with the Vue app instance.

methods.name: app.mount
methods.description: Mounts the Vue app to a DOM element with id 'app'.
